items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Ridgely and Celestine, they made up the Tuxedo band years ago... I was playing with Ridley... The people know Sonny. So that made the people know the both of them.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear of Papa called Zoost? Zoost. Yeah. Did you ever hear that nickname? Yeah.
And that's what they, what they used to call Sonny. They, you know what they used to call Celestan.
Why did they ever get that name? I don't know.
